race.comment: WHY NOW (5) sets the standard despite a plain seventh at St Arnaud, where he was beaten out of sight in a No NR after racing roughly in the back straight. His Hamilton third two runs back reads much better, and the Jackie Barker combination, plus a strong overall record at the trip, gives him the most appealing winning profile. ITGETSBETTER (3) is the logical danger from Fr3, having placed at Ararat after winning a NR up to 45 over 1780m here. BROWN EYED KATE (4) is rock-solid at this track and distance and brings back-to-back thirds, though she was beaten as a very short odds-on chance behind ITGETSBETTER two starts ago. JUDIELLE (1) resumes from a long absence with trials behind her and Fr1 in her favour, but the fresh query is real.
